Dear Madam
I am sending your letter on to a lady who has an old servant in an institution such as you wish for - but I do not know how the appointment was made. I am sending your letter to her and asking her ([Mrs Elgie](../persons.html#475)) to write to you if she knows whether there would be a chance of admission

yours truly

C M Yonge
